message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023**.  
For each holiday I’ve noted the actual date, the day of the week, and the weekend days that combine with it to create a “long weekend.”  (If a holiday falls on a weekend, the observed day is shown in parentheses.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day | Observed (if weekend) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-----|-----------------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sunday | – | **Jan 1–3** (Sun‑Mon‑Tue) |
| Family Day (AB, SK, BC, NB, PE) | Feb 20 | Monday | – | **Feb 18–20** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Friday | – | **Apr 7–9** (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Monday | – | **May 20–22** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Saturday | Jul 3 (Mon) | **Jul 1–3** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Monday | – | **Sep 2–4** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Monday | – | **Oct 7–9** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Saturday | Nov 13 (Mon) | **Nov 11–13** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Monday | – | **Dec 23–25** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 | Tuesday | – | **Dec 24–26** (Sun‑Mon‑Tue) |

### Quick Tips for Your App

1. **Observance Rules** – If a holiday falls on a weekend, the next weekday is usually observed.  
   *Example:* Canada Day fell on Saturday, so the holiday was observed on Monday, July 3.  
2. **Province‑Specific Holidays** – Family Day is celebrated in several provinces (AB, SK, BC, NB, PE).  
3. **Optional Customization** – Some users may want to filter by province or by whether the holiday is statutory or optional.  

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning module or use the data to generate calendar events automatically!
